

# mode.com is all Rust (mode-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mode-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# mode.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mode-rust/src/mode/mode.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mode_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(mode_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(mode_res OBJECT mode.rc)
target_compile_definitions(mode_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(mode_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(mode mode-cargo mode.com
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE mode-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mode_shims mode_res xdk)
